The microwave is black with a glass door and a wooden-patterned front panel.
The brand 'Russell Hobbs' is visible in white text on the front left side of the microwave in both photos.
The control panel on the right side has a large silver dial and several buttons, with a small digital display above them.
The microwave is placed on a speckled granite countertop with a tiled backsplash.
A black power cord is plugged into a white UK-style electrical socket on the wall.

Brand name 'Russell Hobbs' is clearly visible on the front of the microwave in both photos.
The microwave is black with a transparent glass door visible in both photos.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and cord, and a photo of the microwave plugged into a Nigerian socket if possible.

risks.proof: Interior photo showing the turntable, walls, and ceiling of the microwave.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially stained or damaged

Close-up photo of the plug and cord, and if possible, a photo of it plugged into a Nigerian socket.

response.reason: The brand and appearance are confirmed, but critical functional and condition details are missing.
